next.reason: 1985 Report Writer OPEN: 'The minimum and maximum record sizes for a file are established at the time the file is created and must not subsequently be changed' (§1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR18), the sentence the Sequential and Relative I-O OPEN rules also carry. The 2023 statement is §2023:9.1.6 prose with no catalog row: fixed attributes 'cannot be changed throughout the lifetime of the file', among them 'the minimum and maximum logical record size in bytes'. Catalogued parts: §2023:9.1.13.2 item 3 names 'the minimum or maximum length of records allowed for the fixed file attributes'; at OPEN an existing file's attributes 'are compared with the fixed file attributes of the file' (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR10), a conflict giving status 39 (§2023:9.1.13.6 item 7). Both editions leave to the implementor which attributes OPEN validates (§1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR6; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR10). Same requirement.
